resolved_issue: Services hash deep-link initial navigation did not scroll to its target section.
fix: Wait for a layout frame, refresh Lenis dimensions, calculate an absolute numeric scroll destination using native scrollY and a single CSS scroll-margin offset. Use React Router links for the same-page index.
